blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY — A charitable program screened more than 580 public school students in the towns of Alangalang and MacArthur in Leyte to address eyesight problems that hinder academic success, with qualified learners set to receive free prescription eyeglasses in December. The initiative, led by the Mabuhay Deseret Foundation (MDF), seeks to help students who struggle to read lessons written on classroom blackboards and other learning materials because of poor eyesight. Among those hoping to benefit is Charisse, a Grade 6 pupil of MacArthur Central School (MCS), who said she has experienced vision problems for years. READ: Looking through myopia: How blurry […]...
